name: cache-gauge
description: One line above the prompt: how long the prompt cache stays warm, what letting it go cold costs, and how close the context is to compaction

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the cache stays warm after a response

position.title: Position
position.description: above: the full gauge in a band above the prompt; hint: warm and ctx only, at the end of the hint line under the prompt

hintColor.title: Hint colour
hintColor.description: on: with position hint, the gauge draws the whole hint line itself so it can be yellow in the last minute and red when cold; another mod's hint handler running after it is skipped
